definitions.full: H2378. chazoth [ חָזוֺת ] noun [feminine] , only construct יֶעְדּוֺ בַּחֲזוֺת in the visions (prophecies) of Iddo 2Chr 9:29 , the title of a collection of prophetic history, see חָזוֺן 4
